jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Tetra Tech AMT is looking for a Data Analyst to support a highly visible new FAA project in the early stages of executable processes and analytics at the direction of FAA management for pre-departure planning.

Primary job duties and responsibilities may include, but are not limited to the following:

Establish a process for strategic deconfliction in collaboration with internal and external aviation stakeholders for a new FAA Traffic Flow Management Evolution Program for a potential “24/7” operation
Work 40 hours a week but potentially work late night shifts and weekends at times to cover overnight and weekend data modeling needs
Collect historical data, observe network of applicable systems in action, and interview stakeholders to understand operational bottlenecks and business process inefficiencies
Using programming languages, along with specialized software, to potentially build quantitative models to simulate various scenarios
Help determine the most efficient and ideal best course of action (e.g., build data models that translate to lower fuel burden, less aircraft downtime, shorter block times, and faster flights) given a strict set of real-world constraints
Document the FAA process, roles, and responsibilities to enable execution of strategic deconfliction process plan for day of operations in the National Airspace System (NAS)
Work with FAA and industry vendor(s) who will architect and build the analytical data model and provide feedback as necessary
Collaborate with FAA stakeholders and external industry partners (as needed) to obtain necessary data to operate logistically optimized model
Enter data into analytical models (long range and same day planning) to develop strategic deconfliction plans
As needed, support the training of FAA staff on process execution related to newly designed traffic flow management program
Document all lessons learned and FAA process improvement opportunities for evolution of strategic deconfliction processes/capability
Apply knowledge in the domain of operations research to optimize NAS strategic deconfliction plan.
Define post event analysis criteria and data expectations
Document recommended process improvement opportunities
Provide expertise in the design, development, implementation, and analysis of technical FAA products and systems

The Successful Candidate Will Have

Have deep expertise in data collection and modeling in support of the federal government and preferably in support of FAA mission
Understanding of instrument flight operations (IFPs) or flight counts with relation to the National Airspace System (NAS)
Background in NAS variables such as an airport, fix, sector, or other elements and how they can impact a projected demand versus capacity imbalance
Deep analytical thinking, strong programming skills, and the ability to translate highly technical data into actionable, strategic recommendations for non-technical stakeholders
Have some background in air traffic management and airport operations including FAA traffic flow management practices
Possess broad knowledge of operations research procedures, methodologies, and can provide technical expertise in the application of state-of-the-art technology to meet FAA mission and aerospace requirements
Flexible work schedule that may require working at FAA in-person and cover nights, weekends and even some holidays during the year as this is in support of a national and highly visible FAA project
Potentially be on call to cover shifts when anticipated higher days of operations or team members are unavailable/on scheduled vacation
Must have at least 5 years of professional experience supporting projects as a Data Analyst or Data Engineer but preferably in support of the FAA/NASA or at least the federal government
Must have a Bachelor of Science Degree in engineering (e.g. Engineering, Operations Research, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics) or related field

Salary: $105,000 to $118,000 annually. Compensation is based on relevant experience and qualifications.

Tetra Tech is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, sex, marital or familial status, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law. Tetra Tech is a VEVRAA federal contractor and we request priority referral of veterans.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
We're hiring on behalf of a Haystack partner!

The Role
• Support, maintain, and enhance data, reporting, and analytics capabilities across enterprise contact center platforms, with a strong focus on a leading cloud-based contact center solution and related tools.
• Serve as a key technical resource for reporting issues, data quality initiatives, and performance analytics, ensuring insights are accurate, timely, and actionable.
• Partner closely with operations, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable reporting solutions.
• Drive incident resolution, perform root cause analysis, and continuously improve reporting frameworks and data pipelines.
• Interpret complex data analyses and develop insights, reports, and presentations to influence decision-making.
• Design, implement, and automate business and reporting solutions, advising stakeholders on their planning and implementation.

What You'll Need
• Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Science, Business, or a related field, OR equivalent work experience in a directly related field.
• Minimum of eight (8) years of experience in data analytics or a directly related field.
• Experience gathering data and information on targeted variables in an established systematic fashion.
• Proven ability to prepare data for analytic efforts, integrating and consolidating data while ensuring quality and accuracy.
• Experience driving strategic data-informed decisions by consulting with clients and leadership to identify and clarify key business needs.

What's On Offer
• Competitive salary
• Opportunity to work with a leading cloud-based contact center solution.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive impactful data-informed decisions.
• Contribute to continuous improvement of reporting frameworks and data pipelines.

jobs.title: Senior / Staff Python Engineer - REMOTE
jobs.description:
Senior / Staff Python Engineer

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior / Staff Python Engineer to join a rapidly growing SaaS company that is building next-generation, AI-driven platforms. In this role, you'll combine hands-on coding with technical leadership, mentoring other engineers and shaping the direction of complex, highly scalable systems.

You'll work cross-functionally with Product, Design, and DevOps teams to deliver secure, reliable, and performant features while fostering a culture of innovation and engineering excellence.

What You'll Do

Design and develop high-performance, scalable applications across Backend using Python 
Foster technical growth and continuous learning.
Define and implement system architecture to ensure long-term scalability and maintainability.
Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across applications and infrastructure.
Champion best practices in testing, security, and deployment processes.
Partner closely with Product and DevOps in Agile development cycles to deliver impactful features.
Lead efforts to improve CI/CD pipelines and automation for faster, more reliable releases.
Maintain clear technical documentation to support long-term stability and scalability.

What We're Looking For

5+ years of software development experience
Strong expertise in Python and modern frameworks (Flask, FastAPI, Django, etc.).
Hands-on experience with cloud environments such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Familiarity with messaging and asynchronous systems such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or similar.
Strong knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL or similar).
Proficiency with Docker, Kubernetes, and Git.
Experience implementing testing frameworks, code coverage, and quality standards.
Comfortable working in Agile/Scrum environments.
Bonus: Experience with workflow orchestration tools or observability stacks.

What Success Looks Like

You deliver high-quality, reliable features that scale seamlessly with business growth.
Teams are mentored and aligned on technical best practices and processes.
The platform operates with high reliability, security, and performance.
Systems evolve gracefully to support future demands without compromising stability.

Compensation & Perks

Competitive salary: $170,000 - $200,000, plus potential equity.
Fully remote work environment (US-based).
Significant opportunity to own technical decisions and mentor other engineers.
Collaborative culture built on innovation, growth, and impact.

Benefits

Medical | Blue Cross Blue Shield

Multiple PPO plan options with nationwide coverage
100% in-network preventive care
Comprehensive coverage for doctor visits, prescriptions, and mental health

Dental | Guardian

100% coverage for preventive care
80-90% coverage for basic services
50-60% coverage for major services
Orthodontia benefit up to $2,000

Vision | Guardian VSP

$10 exam copay, $20 materials copay
$150 allowance for frames or contacts every 12 months

Life Insurance | Guardian

Company-paid life insurance of $50,000
for all full-time employees

Voluntary Life Insurance | Guardian

Option to purchase additional coverage for yourself, your spouse, and dependents
Spouse coverage up to 50% of employee amount, child coverage up to $10,000

401(k) Retirement Plan

Employer match of 50% of employee contributions, up to $2,350 per year

Immediate eligibility upon hire and full vesting from day one

Discretionary Paid Time Off (PTO)

Take time as needed to recharge and balance personal responsibilities
No fixed accrual - focused on results and trust

Paid Holidays

10 paid company holidays
annually, including major U.S. holidays and year-end break
